tiles.name: solenoid
tiles.subtitle: NCE6020AK
tiles.result: the coil on while CMD is high; I = its current, 1 V/A (up to 2 A); VD = the drain / 52: the flyback's spike, by the jumper
notes: CMD (0 / +1 V) through 10 k into a TLV3501 drives an NCE6020AK (60 V) that switches the coil to ground; VMOT on the coil.
Jumper 1-2: a Schottky to VMOT (slow decay); 2-3: a 24 V TVS (fast decay); none: the FET avalanches.  I 1 V/A, VD drain / 52.

tiles.name: servo
tiles.result: a servo at the angle a 1-2 ms pulse every 20 ms sets (CMD 0 / +1 V); I = the servo's current, 1 V/A
notes: CMD (0 / +1 V from a DAC) through 10 k into a TLV3501 (threshold 0.49 V) makes the 5 V pulse a servo wants; the servo's
ground returns through 0.05 ohm and an INA181A1 (x20) puts 1 V/A on I.  Slew the angle and watch the current.

tiles.name: motor supply
tiles.subtitle: 5-16 V in
tiles.result: VMOT = the larger of the barrel jack or terminal (5-16 V) and USB 5 V, each less a Schottky's 0.3-0.5 V; VM jack VMOT / 16
notes: Barrel jack (centre +) or terminal, 5-16 V: each through an SS34 into VMOT, as is USB's 5 V, so VMOT is about 4.6 V
with no supply.  SMBJ16A and 220 uF on VMOT take the braking energy a motor returns.  VM: VMOT / 16 at high impedance.

tiles.name: hall
tiles.subtitle: DRV5055A3
tiles.result: OUT = 9.75 mV per mT at the sensor (+-0.83 V at +-85 mT), 0 V with no field; about 20 kHz wide
notes: DRV5055A3: 25 mV/mT about half its 5 V supply, ratiometric.  The OPA810 subtracts the same half (20 k / 20 k) and scales
by 0.39: OUT 9.75 mV/mT.  A magnet's distance, a maglev's gap, a gear tooth; the sensor is the small part top left.

tiles.name: optical
tiles.subtitle: QRE1113
tiles.result: OUT = 1 k x the phototransistor's current: about 0.1-0.9 V with white paper 1 mm above the sensor, near 0 V with nothing
notes: QRE1113GR: an IR LED (21 mA through 180 ohm) and a phototransistor side by side.  The OPA810 holds the collector at 0 V
(emitter on -5 V through 100 ohm): OUT = 1 k x Ic.  Distance in the first millimetres, a mark on a wheel, a line.

tiles.name: load cell
tiles.subtitle: INA828
tiles.result: OUT = 201 x the bridge's output: about 1 V at full load for a 1 mV/V cell; about 10 kHz wide
notes: INA828 at G = 1 + 50 k / 249 = 201 on +-5 V, REF on ground; the bridge excited from +5 V.  Weigh, feel a force, close a
force loop with the servo or the linear amplifier.  Cable: 1 red E+, 2 black E-, 3 white S-, 4 green S+.

tiles.name: stepper
tiles.subtitle: 2 x DRV8251A
tiles.result: full, half or PWM microsteps at the rate the FPGA sets (IN1, IN2 per coil); IA, IB = the coil currents' size, 0.98 V/A, 1 A limit
notes: Two DRV8251A from VMOT: coil A IN1 on IO2, IN2 on IO3; coil B IN1 on IO4, IN2 on IO8 (both low: coast, then sleep).
VREF 1.0 V and 620 ohm on IPROPI: 1 A limit, 0.98 V/A through 10 k onto IA and IB.  Stepper on the XH: A+, A-, B+, B-.

tiles.name: linear amp
tiles.subtitle: TCA0372
tiles.result: the load at 4 x IN (+-4 V for +-1 V), about VMOT / 2 at each end; I = the load's current, 1 V/A (+-1 A)
notes: A TCA0372 bridge from VMOT: side A = VMOT/2 - 2 IN, side B = VMOT/2 + 2 IN, so the load sees 4 x IN.  Up to 1 A and about 1 W
in the chip: 8 ohm at 5-6 V, 30 ohm or more at 12 V.  0.1 ohm + INA181 + OPA810: I = 1 V/A.  A voice coil, a maglev magnet.

tiles.name: buck stage
tiles.subtitle: TPS28225
tiles.result: VO = the duty cycle x VMOT at the PWM's frequency (100-500 kHz); I = the inductor's current, 1 V/A (0 when it dips below zero); VO jack VO / 16
notes: PWM (0 / +1 V) squared by a TLV3501 into a TPS28225 driving two AO3400A from VMOT; 47 uH into 2 x 22 uF.  Close the loop
in the FPGA from VO (VO / 16) and I (1 V/A); a load on the terminal, up to 1 A.  The switch holds the driver's EN low.

tiles.name: DC motor
tiles.subtitle: DRV8251A
tiles.result: the motor at the duty and direction IO7 (IN1) and IO1 (IN2) set; I = its current, 0.98 V/A; V = its terminal voltage / 13 (back-EMF in coast)
notes: DRV8251A from VMOT: IN1 (IO7) and IN2 (IO1) choose forward, reverse, brake (both high) or coast (both low: then sleep).
IPROPI (620 ohm, 0.98 V/A, 2 A limit) buffered onto I; (M1 - M2) / 13 onto V.  Encoder A on IO5, B on IO6, its own 3.3 V.

tiles.name: power
tiles.subtitle: USB-C 5 V in: +5, -5, +3.3 out
tiles.result: +5 V from the USB-C (up to 1.5 A), -5 V at 40 mA, +3.3 V at 300 mA; the green LED says 5 V is in, the red one that -5 V is up
notes: USB-C power only: 5.1 k on each CC asks any source for 5 V.  A 2 A PTC, a 5 V TVS (clamps at 9.2 V) and 20 uF.
The LM2664 charge pump makes -5 V for the op-amp tiles (40 mA: four tiles at 10 mA); it is not switched per tile, an op
amp with its +5 V removed draws nothing.  The TPS7A2033 makes 3.3 V for the comparator and the lines that meet the FPGA.
The socket along the top carries +5, ground, -5, ground, +3.3: the bench's rails for a breadboard experiment.

back_text: 5-16 V on m2; USB-C 5 V on m1.
